title: hydrangea corylifolia
intro: Hydrangea corylifolia, commonly known as Chinese hydrangea, is a species of flowering plant in the family Hydrangeaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, relieving fever, and treating respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Hydrangea corylifolia include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides. The plant's bioactive constituents have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and antitumor activities, making it a valuable resource in the development of new medicines.
